description: This file defines the ImportMapSalesforce class, which extends ImportMapOther to specify custom field mappings and import settings related to Salesforce.com data import within the SuiteCRM system. It includes configurations such as delimiters, header presence, and module-specific field mappings for Contacts, Leads, and Accounts.

classes.name: ImportMapSalesforce
classes.description: Extends ImportMapOther to provide Salesforce-specific import mappings and configurations.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns module-specific field mappings, augmenting parent class mappings with Salesforce-specific fields for 'Contacts', 'Leads', and 'Accounts'.

methods.name: getIgnoredFields
methods.description: Returns a list of fields to ignore during import, merging parent class ignored fields with 'id'.
